profile.headline: SDE at Amazon Lab126
profile.summary:
- C/C++ embedded software development
- Network protocol development
   - Wireless network (WLAN) protocol
   - WiFi security feature (IDS/IPS)
   - CAPWAP/802.11i/802.11r/WPA2/WPA3
   - 802.1X/PSK/iPSK/FT
   - SW packet processing using click router
   - Network security features
   - TPM/DevID (802.1AR) & TCAM
   - Multicast protocol development based on RFC (PIM-SM/BSR)
   - Port Extender 802.1BR
   - Broadcom ASIC API (BCM APIs)
   - SW development in Embedded OS (linux/Greenhills)
- Database (RDBMS) development 
   - Internal database knowledge (compiler/optimizer)
- Hands-on experiences in various OS
   - Windows/POSIX/NonStop
- Unit/Regression testing 
   - Harness testing suite for SQL query optimization
   - SQL Compiler simulation
   - Network topology/protocol simulation

Specialties: - Embedded software development using C/C++ in RTOS
- Programming in C/C++/Java/C#/Korn Shell
- JDBC/ODBC programming in MySQL, Oracle, and SQL/MX
- Versioning control tools: GIT, ClearCase, and Subversion

positions.description:
- Investigate/Design/Develop network and security features on network appliances (switch/router)
- Develop DevID (device identity) based on IEEE 802.11AR and TCG TPM 1.2

- Work on IDS to prevent port-scan flooding on the switch

- Work on internet protocol layer (L3) on HP ProCurve switches built on GreenHills RTOS (real-time OS)
- Develop PIM-DM/SM & BSR multicast protocols according to RFC specifications using C/C++

- Worked with test engineers and ASIC engineers to resolve issues found during integrated & performance testing
- Trained new engineers to work in multicast protocol team environment
- Participated in developing a network simulator to develop and test PIM protocol on Windows environment (VS 2005)
- Build and debug network switches/routes in Linux environment using GreenHills Multi IDE

projects.title: WiFi Radar
projects.description:
Using commonly available wifi chipset from vendor, develop software stack that can run algorithm to detection motion using radar samples.

The feature is used by Amazon echo family (dot, studio, and show) combined with Alexa+ capability called 'presence detection' routine. 

Developed the softwaret that run on both Amazon OS (Application Processor) and FreeRTOS (MCU) that would receive radar sample and then run algorithm to notify Alexa cloud for further processing.

projects.title: Facebook eXpress WiFi (XWF) feature development
projects.description: Development SW for Cisco AP to certify with Facebook requirements. This was multi team, multi geographical effort where dynamically worked with various teams.

patents.title: METHOD OF PROCESSING NETWORK SECURITY POLICY OF ELECTRONIC DEVICE
patents.description: Offload security policy from wireless edge devices to client.  For robust wireless transmission.

patents.title: FILTERING OF PACKETS FOR PACKET TYPES AT NETWORK DEVICES
patents.description: Network traffic filtering using ASIC feature. Bloom filter is used to match the traffic for further investigation of the packet. Forwarding decision is made to the packet by another element (this could be SW or other HW appliances).
